Original tunes were contributed by Landes, Lynch, Dover, Kirby and Dugger.

Dacosta Woltz's Southern Broadcasters | DaCosta Woltz was an American old time banjo player from Galax, Virginia.  His band, DaCosta Woltz's Southern Broadcasters played Appalachian old-time string band and square dance music and recorded in the late 1920s.
